ntrpDescriptions.1_5: Still working on getting the ball consistently in play. Learning basic positions and scoring.
ntrpDescriptions.2_0: Obvious stroke weaknesses but familiar with basic positions for singles and doubles play.
ntrpDescriptions.2_5: Starting to judge where the ball is going. Can sustain a slow-paced rally with some consistency.
ntrpDescriptions.3_0: Fairly consistent on medium-paced shots. Not comfortable with all strokes. Lacks control on faster shots.
ntrpDescriptions.3_5: More reliable strokes with directional control on moderate shots. Starting to develop consistency in net play.
ntrpDescriptions.4_0: Dependable strokes with control and depth on both forehand and backhand. Can use lobs, overheads, and volleys with some success.
ntrpDescriptions.4_5: Solid power and consistency. Uses spin effectively. Handles pace well. Can vary game plan according to opponent.
ntrpDescriptions.5_0: Exceptional shot variety with pace and spin. Can execute all strokes reliably. Has developed good anticipation.
ntrpDescriptions.5_5: Mastery of all shots. Can hit winners and force errors. Strong mental game. Tournament-competitive player.
ntrpDescriptions.6_0: Professional-level play. Intensive training for national tournament competition at junior or adult levels.

duprDescriptions.1_0: Just starting out. Learning the basic rules and strokes.
duprDescriptions.2_0: Just getting started. Can serve and return but lacks consistency.
duprDescriptions.2_5: Developing basic strokes. Understands court positioning.
duprDescriptions.3_0: Can sustain short rallies. Working on third-shot drops and dinks.
duprDescriptions.3_5: Developing third-shot drop. Can sustain longer rallies and play at the kitchen line.
duprDescriptions.4_0: Plays longer rallies with patience. Good dinking and net play. Uses variety of shots.
duprDescriptions.4_5: Strong consistency and power. Uses spin and placement effectively. Good reset ability.
duprDescriptions.5_0: Highest level of shot types and placement. Strong strategic play. Tournament-competitive.
duprDescriptions.5_5: Exceptional skill level. Dominant in most recreational and tournament settings.
duprDescriptions.6_0: Professional-level pickleball. Competes at the highest level of the sport.
